invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of getCommitActionType(), which should not return null as it represents a commit action type.
Commit action types should have a non-empty String, assuming the implementation does not return empty strings.
Commit action type strings are likely to have no leading or trailing whitespace.
Commit action types are often represented in uppercase, so this invariant ensures the returned action type follows that convention.
A valid commit action type should have a positive length.
